notes.title: Great news! Project CATS re-branding!
notes.notes:
Attention Project CATS fans!

We are re-branding "Project CATS" and will re-launch it in the near future with a new brand name and a new design - Stay tuned!

notes.title: You Spoke. We Listened. UPDATES
notes.notes:
You Spoke. We Listened. UPDATES

#1. We have lowered the price by 70% to $9.99 USD (the price changes are currently pending approval by Valve).

#2. We have contacted the people that left the two positive reviews on November 5 and asked them to remove the positive reviews ASAP.

#3. We have fixed several bugs which were causing inexplicable issues (the game is in Early Access because it has a few bugs)

#4. We own all game assets (the majority were developed in-house by our team / some assets were purchased from various stores e.g. unity asset store)



Please keep the feedback coming...

You can also email us directly at:
support@projectcats.org

notes.title: Thank you everyone for your feedback and support.
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for your feedback and support. 

We have the best community on the internet!

You Spoke. We Listened. 

We are 100% committed to our customers. Which is why, we make sure that we listen to all your feedback and implement tangible changes that will make your experience better.

We have listened to your feedback and have fixed several bugs!

In order to continue improving the game experience available to you, please keep reporting bugs and please tell us how we can improve, particularly, what features you would like to see in the future.

Please keep the feedback coming... 

You can also email us directly at:
support@projectcats.org
